# AI Decision Policy – VortaForge

This organization is in maintenance pause until 2027-2028.
New feature requests and enhancement PRs are rejected.
Only critical security issues and very simple bug fixes are considered.

## Rules
- New feature / enhancement request → close + reply “Please fork. Maintenance is paused until 2027-2028.”
- Simple typo / README fix → accept and thank the contributor.
- Security issue → add “security” label and reply quickly if possible.
- Issues/PRs with no response for 14 days → add “stale” label, wait 7 more days, then close.
- Spam or nonsense → close immediately.
- Always reply politely and briefly in English.
- Never claim to be human. Clearly state this is an automated system.
